purpose: Test whether the declared public SDMX precision metadata alone can account for the small residuals observed in the terminal semantic-adjusted OECD reconciliation, without changing the frozen 0.1 million RON gate or opening a new value run.

official_sdmx_decimals_definition.definition: Number of digits of an observation to the right of a decimal point.

official_sdmx_national_accounts_dsd_guid.semantic_point: DECIMALS provides the number of decimal digits used in the data; UNIT_MULT supplies the magnitude multiplier.

official_bnr_internal_consistency.source: NBR / CMFB Level 3 national financial-accounts quality report
official_bnr_internal_consistency.semantic_point: Romanian quarterly financial accounts are built who-to-whom and have no asset/liability discrepancies by construction; no quantitative reliability measure is supplied at national level.

retained_oecd_response_metadata.lexical_obs_value_format_seen: integer or one visible decimal in retained CSV; trailing zeros may be omitted by serialization

conservative_declared_precision_test.assumption: For diagnostic purposes only, allow up to one full declared last-decimal quantum per disseminated observation. This is more conservative than round-to-nearest and does not assume an OECD rounding mode.

system_identity.algebra: H+C+F+G+BNR+X collapses to S1M+S11+S12+S13+S2 because F=S12-S121 and BNR=S121 cancel exactly.

adjudication.reason: The official DECIMALS=2 metadata does not provide an adequate independent precision explanation for all public-accounting diagnostics. A coarser lexical display cannot be substituted for an official dissemination precision/rounding rule after observing the residuals.

future_reopen_condition: Require an official domain-specific financial-accounts dissemination rule that quantitatively defines the precision/rounding or balancing tolerance of the published OECD/ECB/BNR values, or a changed public source whose exact values satisfy the frozen accounting identity. Generic DECIMALS metadata or lexical formatting alone is insufficient.
